# MongoDB Atlas for Government

> Explore MongoDB Atlas for Government, a fully managed cloud database for U.S. federal, state, and local agencies with unique government-specific features.

- [AtlasGov Programmatic Access](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/api.md): Learn how to access Atlas for Government programmatically using the API, Kubernetes Operator, or Terraform, including authentication methods and limitations.
- [AtlasGov User Access](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-access.md): Learn how to create and manage MongoDB Atlas for Government user accounts, including account security measures and invitation-based access.
- [MongoDB Search](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/atlas-search.md): Explore advanced text indexing with MongoDB Search, available in Atlas for Government, to enhance search functionality without extra management.
- [Subscriptions and Billing](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/billing.md): Purchase and activate a MongoDB Atlas for Government subscription through AWS, Google Cloud, or MongoDB Sales.
- [Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/clusters.md): Explore clusters in Atlas for Government, including options for replica sets and sharded clusters in AWS GovCloud regions.
- [Backup and Restore Cluster Data](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/clusters/backup-restore-data.md): Manage backups and restore data for clusters in MongoDB Atlas for Government projects, ensuring compliance with region-specific restrictions.
- [Monitoring, Logging and Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/clusters/monitoring.md): Configure monitoring, logging, and alerts for MongoDB Atlas for Government clusters, including integration with third-party services like Datadog.
- [Database Users](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/database-access.md): Create database users in Atlas for Government to manage access to clusters based on assigned roles.
- [Getting Started](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/getting-started.md): Create a MongoDB Atlas for Government account, organization, project, cluster, and database user with this getting started guide.
- [Migrate or Import Data into Your Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/import-data.md): Learn how to migrate or import data into your MongoDB Atlas for Government cluster using the Atlas Live Migration Service with minimal application downtime.
- [MongoDB Atlas for Government](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/index.md): Explore MongoDB Atlas for Government, a fully managed cloud database for U.S. federal, state, and local agencies with unique government-specific features.
- [AtlasGov Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview.md): Explore MongoDB Atlas for Government, a fully-managed cloud database for U.S. federal and state, local, and education (SLED) agencies and their cloud regions.
- [MongoDB Atlas for Government Considerations](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/atlasgov-considerations.md): Explore the key differences, restrictions, and security features of MongoDB Atlas for Government compared to standard Atlas.
- [Supported Features](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-features.md): Explore the features supported by Atlas for Government, including unique capabilities and comparisons with standard Atlas offerings.
- [Supported Cloud Providers and Regions](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/overview/supported-regions.md): Explore the supported regions for deploying MongoDB Atlas for Government clusters on AWS GovCloud, AWS Commercial, and Google Cloud with Assured Workloads.
- [Security](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/security.md): Explore security features in MongoDB Atlas for Government, including TLS 1.2, FIPS 140-2 compliance, encryption at rest, VPC peering, and private endpoints.
- [Support](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/support.md): Access premium support for MongoDB Atlas for Government with guaranteed US-based assistance and specific user roles for raising support cases.
- [Add Your Connection IP Address to IP Access List](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/allow-ip.md): Add your IP address to the IP access list in MongoDB Atlas for Government to connect securely to your cluster.
- [Create an Account](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-account.md): Create a MongoDB Atlas for Government account by purchasing a subscription or accepting an invitation, and follow steps to register and log in.
- [Create a Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-cluster.md): Follow this tutorial to create a replica set cluster in Atlas for Government, including selecting cloud provider, region, and configuring auto-scaling.
- [Create a Database User for Your Cluster](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-mongodb-user-for-cluster.md): Create a database user with SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication to access your MongoDB Atlas for Government cluster securely.
- [Create an Organization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-organization.md): Create an organization in Atlas for Government by following steps to add members and specify their access.
- [Create a Project](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/government/tutorial/create-project.md): Create a project in Atlas for Government, designating it for standard or government region use, and manage member access.
